issue_summary_neutral: Following a DoT reference, TRAI sought stakeholder views on whether a hybrid LPWAN-plus-satellite model, a direct-to-satellite model, or some other model should be permitted to provide satellite-based connectivity for IoT and low-bit-rate applications; which satellite types (GSO/MEO/LEO) and frequency bands should be allowed; and whether a wholly new licensing framework is needed or the existing framework should be amended to cover such connectivity.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: licensing framework for satellite-based low-bit-rate connectivity
notes: Frame H systematic sample: chronological order, interval=2.6, start=1.3, this is sample index 1/20 (chronological position 1 of 52).

issue_summary_neutral: TRAI sought stakeholder views on whether there is sufficient competition among consumer options for television distribution services, and whether the current regulatory framework and market structure require new measures to address possible monopoly, oligopoly or market dominance in the cable TV distribution sector.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: market structure and competition in cable TV services
notes: Frame H systematic sample index 2/20 (chronological position 4 of 52).

issue_summary_neutral: TRAI sought views on whether a specific licence is needed for establishing a Satellite Earth Station Gateway (SESG) in India to provide satellite-based resources to service licensees, what such a licence's scope/technical/financial obligations should be, who should be eligible to hold it, and what mechanism should govern access to satellite transponder capacity.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: licensing framework for satellite earth station gateways
notes: Frame H systematic sample index 3/20 (chronological position 6 of 52).

issue_summary_neutral: TRAI sought stakeholder views across a wide range of licensing, permission, registration and reporting/compliance issues affecting ease of doing business in the telecom and broadcasting sectors, including whether the present system of licenses/permissions/registrations across MIB/DoT/WPC/NOCC/TEC/DOS/MeitY/MoP needs improvement, and how TRAI's own reporting and compliance systems could be simplified.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: ease of doing business in telecom and broadcasting sector
notes: Frame H systematic sample index 4/20 (chronological position 9 of 52).

issue_summary_neutral: TRAI sought stakeholder views on whether the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme in its current form is effective for promoting networking and telecom equipment manufacturing (NATEM) in India, whether further financial/fiscal incentives are needed, whether the Electronic Development Fund (EDF) meets sector requirements, and what measures could support the telecom start-up and equipment-financing ecosystem.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: promoting networking and telecom equipment manufacturing in India
notes: Frame H systematic sample index 5/20 (chronological position 12 of 52).

issue_summary_neutral: TRAI sought stakeholder views on classifying buildings/areas from a digital-connectivity perspective, the roles Infrastructure Providers and Digital Connectivity Infrastructure Providers should play, and how a ratings ecosystem to design, deploy and evaluate in-building digital connectivity infrastructure (DCI) should be structured and governed.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: rating of buildings or areas for digital connectivity
notes: Frame H systematic sample index 6/20 (chronological position 14 of 52). A companion 'Extension Letter' PDF (PR_No.27of2022.pdf) is an image-only scan that did not OCR in this environment; its extension date is not independently captured here (see NOTES.md).

issue_summary_neutral: Acting on a DoT reference, TRAI sought stakeholder views on which frequency band and how much spectrum should be assigned to the National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) for its LTE-R-based train control system on RRTS rail corridors, and whether the same spectrum could also serve other RRTS/Metro rail networks elsewhere in India.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: spectrum requirements for a regional rapid transit train-control system
notes: Frame H systematic sample index 7/20 (chronological position 17 of 52).

issue_summary_neutral: TRAI sought stakeholder views on whether its earlier-recommended timeline for foreign eUICC (embedded SIM)-fitted devices to remain on roaming with an Indian TSP's network before mandatory local-profile conversion needs review, and on related profile-management (SM-DP/SM-SR) issues for M2M eSIM devices imported into India.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: embedded SIM rules for M2M communications
notes: Frame H systematic sample index 8/20 (chronological position 20 of 52).

issue_summary_neutral: TRAI sought stakeholder views on how to define Artificial Intelligence for telecom-sector purposes, the requirements and challenges of developing/deploying AI models, whether big data in telecom can be leveraged for AI model development, whether 5G-and-beyond technologies would accelerate AI adoption, and whether related terminology (Trustworthy/Responsible/Explainable AI) needs harmonised definitions.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: leveraging artificial intelligence and big data in the telecom sector
notes: Frame H systematic sample index 9/20 (chronological position 22 of 52).

issue_summary_neutral: TRAI sought stakeholder views on whether data communication services between aircraft and ground stations, provided by organisations other than the Airports Authority of India, should be brought under a service-licensing regime, and if so whether such licensing should be via a Unified Licence authorisation or a separate service licence.
neutral_title: TRAI consultation: licensing regime for aircraft-to-ground-station data communication services
notes: Frame H systematic sample index 10/20 (chronological position 25 of 52). See also IN-TRAI-H-0016, a Supplementary Consultation Paper on the same underlying topic (2023-08-03), treated as a separate thread per protocol since it poses its own distinct supplementary questions (spectrum auction design) and was sampled at a different chronological position.
